name: action-bar

frames.best_why: The floating bar is fully readable with 1 selected, and a hovered row shows the selection styling.

tagline: Floating bar slides up with the selected count, duplicate and delete.
summary: A small rounded toolbar that appears at the bottom of the screen when list rows are checked. It reports how many are selected and offers Duplicate, Delete and a close button.
appearance: A compact dark pill at the bottom centre of the screen holds a boxed "1 selected" count, a small close cross, a Duplicate button with a copy icon and a red Delete button with a bin.
behaviour: The bar is absent until a row is checked, then fades and zooms in from below. The count updates as more rows are selected; an action or the close cross dismisses it.
demo_content: Five rows: Weekly Status Report, Client Invoice Review, Q3 Roadmap, Team Standup, Onboarding.
search_phrases: bulk actions bar for selected rows
bulk edit menu appears on select
toolbar that pops up when rows checked
use_when: A table or task list lets people select several rows and needs one place for bulk actions.
avoid_when: It is fixed to the viewport, so it can cover content, and it only appears with an external selection state.
customise: Open state, side, alignment and offsets, escape handler, direction, orientation and loop are props; the count label and action items are composed as children.
weight_why: A single portalled bar with a short entry animation; nothing runs while closed.

a11y.note: Roving focus, arrow keys and Escape work, but the icon-only close button has no accessible name.

polish_why: Clean, conventional toolbar in the shadcn idiom; the close icon is tiny and unlabelled.
title: Action Bar
